2608.26019.title: DualOPSD: Adaptive Privileged Teachers for On-Policy Self-Distillation
2608.26019.paper_summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a privileged copy of the student model to provide dense supervision without an external teacher. OPSD keeps this privileged teacher fixed, even though the student distribution and output style change during training. We propose DualOPSD, an asymmetric alternating framework that adapts both policies. The student first learns from the privileged teacher. The teacher then moves toward the updated student distribution on the same student trajectory. This update makes later supervision responsive to the learner and does not require another rollout. On Qwen3-8B in non-thinking mode, DualOPSD improves avg@12 over OPSD by 23.61, 13.89, and 10.00 points on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025. Results at 1.7B and 4B show that the accuracy gain depends on model scale. Across all three scales, DualOPSD reduces truncation. The 4B diagnostic also shows lower KL in both directions between the teacher and student.
2608.26019.paper_summary_zh: 在政策自我蒸餾（OPSD）中，使用學生模型的特權副本來提供密集的監督，而不需要外部教師。OPSD 保持這個特權教師不變，即使學生的分佈和輸出風格在訓練過程中發生變化。我們提出了 DualOPSD，一種不對稱的交替框架，能夠適應兩種政策。學生首先從特權教師那裡學習。然後，教師在相同的學生軌跡上朝著更新的學生分佈移動。這一更新使得後續的監督能夠對學習者做出反應，並且不需要再次進行回合。在非思考模式下的 Qwen3-8B，DualOPSD 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 HMMT 2025 上分別比 OPSD 提高了 23.61、13.89 和 10.00 分的 avg@12。1.7B 和 4B 的結果顯示，準確度的提升取決於模型的規模。在所有三種規模中，DualOPSD 減少了截斷。4B 的診斷結果也顯示教師和學生之間的 KL 值在兩個方向上都較低。
